concerns.text: FR-004 computes degree, betweenness, and eigenvector centrality on a graph that includes EEG, EOG, and EMG channels. The original idea specifies centrality derived from *brain* functional connectivity; adding peripheral non‑neural channels changes the predictor definition and undermines the research question.

The specification references a functional requirement FR-012 (Shapiro‑Wilk normality test) in the analysis description, but FR-012 is not defined in the Requirements section, creating an undefined requirement.

Success Criterion SC-002 imposes a wall‑clock runtime limit of < 4 hours on the full pipeline. The original idea does not request any performance bound, and this engineering constraint is not justified by the scientific question or reproducibility needs.
Success Criterion SC-003 limits peak RAM usage to < 4 GB. Like the runtime bound, this is an engineering metric absent from the idea and not tied to answering the research question.

FR-009 adds Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) calculation for centrality metrics. The idea never mentions collinearity diagnostics; this is an extra analysis not required to address the stated hypothesis.
